key_insight: Perovskite-based tandem photovoltaics can significantly enhance sustainability in the solar energy sector.
engineering_relevance: Improving the circularity of solar cells is crucial as the demand scales to terawatts, addressing both performance and environmental concerns.
method: Examine substitution of scarce raw materials.
evidence_signal: By 2050, crystalline silicon photovoltaics may produce 160 million tonnes of waste, highlighting the need for sustainable alternatives.
watch_item: The integration of effective policy frameworks to support recycling and circularity remains a critical challenge.
paper_title: Circularity in Perovskite-Based Tandem Photovoltaics for Terawatt-Scale Deployment
